validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's Location cluster (SheetRow 147) gives EndState/Province='Mississippi', EndPrefecture/District='Noxubee County' for the OPERATING 118-mile/122 MMcf/d Magnolia system. Every independent source found places the operating system entirely within Alabama. GEM's own wiki page (read for leads only, never cited) already states this correctly in prose: the operating pipeline 'runs from Chilton County, Alabama through Bibb County, Tuscaloosa County, Greene County, and Hale County, Alabama' and separately describes a distinct, PROPOSED, on-hold 'Magnolia Extension' project (Status: On-hold; proposed capacity 500 MMcf/d; length 45 mi) that would run 'through Pickens County, Alabama and into Noxubee County, Mississippi' to reach Tennessee Gas Pipeline's 500 Line -- i.e. the Noxubee County/Mississippi endpoint belongs to the UNBUILT extension, not to this operating row. Independent confirmation: (1) FERC Federal Register notice (Dec 12 1997, Docket PR98-2-000) states Magnolia 'owns and operates pipeline facilities within the State of Alabama' -- no Mississippi mention. (2) American Midstream/Third Coast Midstream 10-Ks for FY2013, FY2016 and FY2018 (SEC EDGAR CIK 0001513965) each describe the Magnolia System as located in 'Tuscaloosa, Greene, Bibb, Chilton and Hale counties of Alabama' with the sole named interconnect being Transco -- again no Mississippi county appears anywhere in the asset description across 3 separate filing years. (3) The wiki's own cited napipelines.com article (Feb 29 2016; read via Wayback, live copy unreachable) is ONLY about the proposed 45-mile EXTENSION ('planning a 45-mile extension of the existing Magnolia Intrastate pipeline... to transport up to 500 million cubic feet per day... beginning in 2019'), confirming the extension is the Mississippi-reaching, not-yet-built project, separate from the operating row being audited. No source anywhere states the currently operating Magnolia system reaches Mississippi. This reads as the extension's planned endpoint having been merged onto the base/operating row's Location cluster. I could not pin the exact terminus county from a primary source (the 10-Ks list the 5-county footprint without specifying start/end order); gem.wiki's own routing order (ending Hale County) is a plausible lead for follow-up but is uncited per standing rule 1.
